title: More Residually Solvable One-Relator Groups
summary: We say a word in a free group is ``partially positive'' if there is at least one generator which appears in the word, but does not appear with negative exponent. We show that one-relator groups with a partially positive relator are residually solvable. This extends a theorem of Baumslag showing one-relator groups with positive relators are residually solvable.
